comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a sprung hinged frame and close it until latched.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated small-part placement on narrow supports followed by force-controlled frame closure.
comparison.success_condition: All modules seated with lugs engaged, frame clicked shut, no forced closure or dropped module, hands clear.
comparison.reason: The central outcome is retaining several modules during sprung-frame closure. It does not transfer a carriage between collinear supports or preserve freely circulating balls.
